*Only this work meets the criterion of “only listed performer on the album”.*  
(Other Berlioz recordings in Bernstein’s catalogue—e.g., *Harold in Italy* (with Donald McInnes, viola), *Requiem* (with Stuart Burrows, tenor & choir)—include additional performers, so they are excluded.)

---

### Other conductors who have recorded **Symphonie fantastique** with *Orchestre National de France* (or its historical name variants) – as per Discogs (catalogue entries active on or before 01 Jan 2025)

| Orchester name used on the recording | Conductor | Year of release (as listed on Discogs) | Discogs master or release ID |
|--------------------------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| **Orchestre National de France** | James Conlon | 1984 | Master #975491 |
| **Orchestre National de France** | Sir Thomas Beecham (stereo version) | 1961 | Master #490742 |
| **Orchestre national de l’ORTF** (historical name for the same national orchestra) | Sir Thomas Beecham (mono version) | 1958 (not listed on Discogs prior to 2025; the mono version was issued in 1958 but not yet entered into Discogs by 01 Jan 2025) | – |
| **Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française** (historical ORTF designation) | Sir Thomas Beecham | 1961 | Master #490742 |

> **Note on historical name variants**  
> The *Orchestre National de France* has also been known by the names *Orchestre national de l’ORTF* and *Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française* during the 1950s‑1960s. The Discogs entries above reflect those variations and are all recordings of  Berlioz’s *Symphonie fantastique* with the same instrumental ensemble.

---

### Summary

- **Only one Berlioz work in Bernstein’s discography** satisfies the requirement (no soloist or additional performers are listed): *Symphonie fantastique* (Op. 14).
- **Three conductors, through Discogs listings, have recorded the same work with the same mezzo‑national orchestra**:

| Conductor | Orchester variant | Year (Discogs) |
|----------|------------------|---------------|
| James Conlon | Orchestre National de France | 1984 |
| Sir Thomas Beecham | Orchestre National de France / Orchestre National de l’ORTF / Orchestre National de la Radiodiffusion Française | 1961 (stereo) |

These are all the conductors who, as of 1 January 2025, have recordings of symphonic‑Berlioz works with *Orchestre National de France* or its historical name variants, according to the Discogs database.
